record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, reduce each causal block's residual-update multiplier from 0.5 to 0.35. The improvement at 0.5 motivates testing whether further damping preserves useful input information through the six-block stack. Keep block count, dilation schedule, embeddings, features, history/readout, scoring, loss and optimizer fixed. Update residual-scale metadata and predictor compatibility checks.

category_rationales.rationale: Test residual scaling of 0.45 across all four datasets, a smaller reduction from the incumbent 0.5 than the previously evaluated 0.35. Keep causal convolutions, embeddings, features, readout, scoring, loss, optimizer and training limits fixed, with one checkpoint per dataset.
